concepts.label: system:indexes / system:all_indexes - FTS indexes queryable from SQL++
concepts.note: No prior registry term; describes the SQL++ system keyspaces (system:indexes, system:all_indexes) through which FTS indexes can be discovered/queried.

cross_component_finding: This page bridges the fts/ and n1ql/ components: it documents querying FTS indexes via the SQL++ system:indexes and system:all_indexes system keyspaces and links directly into the N1QL Search Functions limitations documentation. system:indexes and system:all_indexes may warrant a shared concept across the FTS and N1QL ontologies rather than being FTS-specific.
